title: Fresh Fried Fish
english_text: Fresh fried fish, fish fresh fried, fried fish fresh.
chinese_text: 新鲜的炸鱼，鱼新鲜地炸，炸鱼真新鲜。
phonetic_tips: 注意 /f/ 上齿咬下唇，与 /ʃ/ 翘舌音区分
linking_tips: Fresh_fried 连读，fish_fresh 保持清晰
